scope: Live v2 SQL on a real subset plus synthetic administration, not full-generation query counts

subset.selection: All accepted MAD-AIR original_time Jan 1 + first 64 MAD-TRAFFIC in accepted file

postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 16.15 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

ddl_limitations_reproduced.notice: These are open integrity limitations, NOT academic or physical PASS claims

sample.name: Ctra. Acceso Estación de Hortaleza - Virgen del Carmen-Av. San Luis
DR. MARTIN AREVALO ENTRE Ø34 Y P.P. O-E(ALBINO HDEZ. LAZARO-REAL PINTO)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (sensor_id, station_id) REFERENCES smartcity.sensors(sensor_id, station_id)
FOREIGN KEY (station_id, source_id) REFERENCES smartcity.stations(station_id, source_id)
FOREIGN KEY (channel_id, source_id) REFERENCES smartcity.channels(channel_id, source_id)

CHECK ((((source_id = 'MAD-AIR'::text) AND (quality_flag = 'V'::text) AND (timestamp_status = 'documented_local'::text) AND (integration_sample_count IS NULL)) OR ((source_id = 'MAD-TRAFFIC'::text) AND (quality_flag = 'N'::text) AND (element_type = ANY (ARRAY['URB'::text, 'M30'::text])) AND (interval_minutes = 15) AND (integration_sample_count IS NOT NULL) AND (integration_sample_count > 0) AND (timestamp_role = 'publisher_label'::text) AND (timestamp_status = 'publisher_confirmed_local'::text) AND (value >= (0)::double precision))))
FOREIGN KEY (source_version, source_id) REFERENCES smartcity.source_versions(source_version, source_id)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER observation_source BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON smartcity.observations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION smartcity.consistent_observation_source()
